name: commute_transvections_iff_of_basis
statement: Type*} [Nontrivial ι] (b : Basis ι R V) {f : V →ₗ[R] V} (hcomm : ∀ i j (r : R) (_ : i ≠ j), Commute f (transvection (b.coord i) (r • b j))) : ∃ a : Subring.center R, f = a • 1

name: exists_mem_center_apply_eq_smul_of_forall_notLinearIndependent
statement: V →ₗ[R] V} (hV1 : finrank R V ≠ 1) (h : ∀ v, ¬ LinearIndependent R ![v, f v]) : ∃ a : Subring.center R, f = a • 1
